desc: It is hereby informed that the 35th Annual General Meeting of the Company will be held on Wednesday 30th September 2026 through Video Conferencing Other Audio-Visual facility.
Please find the enclosed Annual Report under Regulation 34 of SEBI (LODR).

Pursuant to the applicable provisions of the Companies Act, 2013 and SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015, we are enclosing extracts of newspaper publication dated September 09, 2026 published in Pioneer (English & Hindi), regarding the dispatch of  the Notice of 35th Annual General of the Company.
